verdict.rationale: Granola Chat is a built-in assistant that takes delegated post-meeting tasks: it can draft and send follow-up emails, draft and send Slack messages, and find a time to create Google Calendar events. Reusable Recipes, overnight pre-meeting briefs and automatic follow-up email drafts add to this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the chat workflows work as described, and documentation of the action scope beyond a few listed workflows.
